folds.heading: ## Later project-wide intake scope, 2026-11-04 (B76)
folds.body: “Single current list” and zero unresolved units above refer to the frozen October 16 closure set. The explicit November 4 request now authorizes continuous actual-content review of remaining audits/plans/ideas/maps; it is new scope, not a revival of the retired automatic31 queue or proof that all earlier unread sources were clean. [Current intake and batch record](../../audits/LOOSE_DOCUMENT_RECONCILIATION_2026-11-04.md) keeps its own denominator and exact ranges. UA/RG archive equivalence, exact consumer/focus cases and historical failed/seeded receipts retain their evidence limits; this pass does not close them by routing. AD42 makes human feedback optional, without turning source/focused-test evidence into rebuilt behavior. The in-place archive policy remains useful: preserve source IDs, original variants and proof, with current owners/explicit residuals. No report deletion, runtime restoration/integration or new source acquisition is authorized by these dated closure instructions (AD32/AD36).

folds.heading: ## Current presence versus historical integration findings, 2026-11-04 (B76)
folds.body: The six representative paths described as absent above now exist in the primary checkout: lever_practice_supply, check_resolver, craft_cues, the RT fixture helper, village_traveler_asks and simfuzz/run. This read-only presence observation prevents reuse of the October 15 absence claims as current status; it does not compare bytes to the isolated candidates, establish complete integration or rerun their behavior. LP2/LP3 combined provenance, seeded stock/skip-travel limits, TA1 revisions, SIMFUZZ repros and unavailable private/untracked originals remain distinct. Use later actual receiving owners and current consumers for implementation claims, preserving the original hashes and narrow source windows as history. AD32/AD36 select no restore, merge, repair or new gameplay queue here.
